roster_audit.premise_tested: The brief states Aurora had a recent roster change and that a team with a real upset shot should be considered (roster changes, onboarding, rest).
roster_audit.finding: Aurora's last documented roster change is the international rebuild completed on 2026-07-08, when kyxsan joined from Falcons as IGL after Jimpphat and coach ash. That is about 100 days before the day-3 decider, so 'recent' is not supported by the sources read here; what is supported is a still-new system (new IGL, new coach, new language) that the coach himself described in August as inconsistent in official matches.

roster_audit.hltv_primary_detail: Re-read on HLTV: the article itself says kyxsan joined from Falcons to "complete their summer rebuild", following the additions of Jimpphat and ash earlier that Friday, and that the new trio replaced MAJ3R, soulfly and Fabre; the five is XANTARES, woxic, Wicadia, Jimpphat, kyxsan with ash coaching, debuting at BLAST Bounty 2026 Season 2 on 21 July. This corroborates the 2026-07-03 / 2026-07-08 dates already published.

day1_upset_review.crowd_at_the_time: HotSpawn crowd ownership before the day-1 match put Aurora at 90% of picks and 9z at 10% (own lobby read 2026-10-16T07:25Z shows the same split for the rematch; the day-1 split is the canonical snapshot's own record).
why_9z_had_a_real_shot: One team, one group: 9z had already beaten this exact five-man Aurora on this stage 2-0, and the H2H note on HLTV's odds page records 9z winning the latest of two meetings inside 30 days.
Aurora's rebuild is a new IGL + new coach + language switch completed 2026-07-08, and the coach described the official-match execution as still developing in August.
The leaderboard maths is asymmetric: a 9z win pays about 3.3x the crowd, an Aurora win barely moves a leaderboard where 90% of entries already carry Aurora.
day1_upset_review.hltv_detail_verified: 9z 2-0 Aurora on 14 Oct (HLTV 2399384, "Group A opening match"): Inferno 13-11, Nuke 13-1; 9z closed Nuke 11-1 on the T side.

research_irregularities.item: Repeated price pairs inside one source
research_irregularities.detail: Melbet's feed publishes the identical decimal pair on unrelated fixtures in the same capture (1.42/2.698 on 1081526 and 1081530; 2.04/1.69 on 1081527 and 1081532), and Kalshi's 0.125/0.875 midpoint appears on 1081120 and 1080289. The prices are published as the source states them, with a repeated_price_pair flag, so a reviewer can judge whether the feed is templating low-tier events.

research_irregularities.item: Lobby timestamps carry no zone label
research_irregularities.detail: play.hotspawn.com renders each tip in US-Eastern without a zone; UTC kick-offs here come from the lobby's own JSON payload (scheduled_start_time, epoch ms) and are cross-checked against the canonical capture and HLTV's display.

Bushido Wildcats vs ex-RUSTEC and ex-Zero Tenacity vs UNiTY are each priced by exactly one Melbet quotation at 1.87/1.87, which is a market 50/50, not a missing row. The desk publishes the tie and its declared tiebreak instead of inventing a direction.

research_irregularities.item: Crowd shares can round to 101% per side
research_irregularities.detail: The lobby rounds each side's picked percentage independently (e.g. 88/13 on another board's row). Leverage is computed from the published shares as they are.

research_irregularities.item: HotSpawn's fixture feed calls months-old matches 'scheduled'
research_irregularities.detail: All 95 CS2 fixtures in the 2026-10-16T04:59:14Z lobby capture carry status 'scheduled', yet 59 of them start before that read - 58 in June 2026 and 1 in July 2026 (earliest 2026-06-26T10:30:00Z, European Pro League Series 8 Play-In). The status flag is therefore not a usable state indicator: this pipeline treats lock_time as the only pick-eligibility signal and never infers a result from 'scheduled'.

research_irregularities.item: Lobby headline count and the fixture payload disagree
research_irregularities.detail: The rendered lobby page advertises 149 matches while the fixture transfer state embedded in that same page returns 95 Counter-Strike 2 fixtures (and the workspace's own capture records fixtures_in_transfer_state = 95). This site therefore reports the 95 rows it can verify line by line and does not restate the 149 figure.

research_irregularities.item: Pick lock is 360 s before kick-off
research_irregularities.detail: Every fixture's lock_time is exactly 360 s (6 min) before its scheduled_start_time (lock_offset_sec = 360 on all 95 rows). Picks therefore cannot be entered in the last six minutes; the desk prints the lock time, not the start time, next to every pick.
